headline: Interface Misses Third-Quarter Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Interface reported third-quarter earnings that missed analyst estimates by $0.01, while revenue also fell short of consensus expectations.
why: Quarterly earnings reports provide direct insights into corporate financial health, operational efficiency, and demand trends within specific industries.

impacts.name: Interface
impacts.why: An earnings and revenue miss directly pressures the company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
